name: reward-bench-gpt2-yes-no
description: A small dataset intended for evaluating or training reward models on binary (yes/no) judgments of GPT-2 outputs. It contains examples labeled with yes/no preferences to measure how well a reward model predicts binary preferences or classifications for generated text. Useful for lightweight reward-model accuracy checks and preference prediction experiments.
reputation: A small community dataset on Hugging Face with limited adoption, mainly used for toy reward-model experiments.
